scope: Offline verification only; no model request, prompt, scoring rule, answer or sealed item changes
finding: The deterministic local tool has a five-second timeout and does not record its output. Under host load its missing tool output changes downstream prompt keys during replay. A single-item replay reproduces the originally recorded key.
mechanism: Recompute the same label-blind solver offline with up to 60 seconds. Try its exact deterministic output and its historical absent-output branch. Accept only a branch with a complete chain of existing exact request keys. Never select by expected verdict or benchmark label. Assert all originally answered decisions unchanged.
